exposure: fetal inflammatory response in the setting of amniotic fluid infection
fetal vascular malperfusion with maternal vascular malperfusion
cohort: The study included 265 placentas from neonates with HIE and 122 placentas from a control group of neonates without HIE, observed from 2002-2022.
finding: Neonates with HIE were more likely to have anatomic umbilical cord abnormalities, fetal inflammatory response, and fetal vascular malperfusion, with fetal vascular malperfusion combined with maternal vascular malperfusion being more common in those who died of the disease.
